semantics: PLANNED next-epoch reallocation per vault per gauge — Votion’s published intention, not yet cast on chain; firms up as voteBefore approaches. The on-chain vote-shift (vote-state vs last payout) is the committed counterpart.
aggregate_semantics: per gauge per pool, summed across captured vaults: current VP vs the VP Votion has ALREADY DECIDED to place (skipped gauges keep current — matching the “not worth changing” rows in Votion’s UI). Coverage = the vault slugs captured this run; add slugs to complete it.
